''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' establishes that the ''Steadfast'' became Ren's flagship after the [[Battle of Batuu]], which is dated to [[34 ABY]] per ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''. ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''The Rise of Skywalker'' to [[35 ABY]]. temple ruins [[Orbital bombardment|orbitally bombarded]]{{StoryCite|story=See You Around, Kid|book=Star Wars (2020) 25}} |type=[[Jedi temple]][[The Rise of Kylo Ren 1|''The Rise of Kylo Ren'' 1]] |location=[[Ossus]]''[[Shadow of the Sith]]'' |interest=*[[Ben Solo's hut]]{{Film|VIII}} *[[Luke's hut (Ossus)|Luke's hut]] |rebuilt= |builder=[[Luke Skywalker]][[The Rise of Kylo Ren 3|''The Rise of Kylo Ren'' 3]] |height= |width= |affiliation=[[Jedi Order]] }} {{Quote|Leia trusted me with her son. I took him, and a dozen students, and began a training temple. By the time I realized I was no match for the darkness rising in him, it was too late.|Luke Skywalker, to Rey|}} The '''Jedi Temple of Luke Skywalker''', also known as '''Luke Skywalker's Jedi Academy''', '''Skywalker's Jedi academy''', or simply the '''Jedi Academy''', was a [[Jedi temple]] located on [[Ossus]] that was used by [[Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker]] to [[Jedi training|train]] a [[Jedi Order|new generation]] of [[Jedi]] during the [[New Republic Era]]. Skywalker trained [[Din Grogu|Grogu]], [[Ben Solo]], and many other students in and around the temple grounds. Following a confrontation between Skywalker and Solo, his [[Padawan|apprentice]] and [[Skywalker family|nephew]], the temple was [[Destruction of the Jedi Temple|destroyed]] by Solo with a powerful lightning storm. ==Description== {{Quote|There is no place in the galaxy more safe than here with Luke.|Ahsoka Tano|{{BOBF|Chapter 6: From the Desert Comes a Stranger}}}} [[Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker]]'s [[Jedi training|training]] [[Jedi temple|temple]] consisted of a jar-shaped structure and several wooden huts. It was built on [[Ossus]], a location that was a secret known only among the [[Jedi Order]].''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'' These structures were destroyed by [[Ben Solo]] when he raged over his confrontation with Skywalker, causing a lightning storm to burn the temple and [[Death|kill]] many of Skywalker's [[Padawan|Jedi apprentices]]. The temple also had a designated area where [[starship]]s, such as the ''[[Verity]]'' and the [[Grimtaash (starship)|''Grimtaash'']], could be stored. ==History== ===A Jedi's quest=== {{Quote|And ''why'' exactly are we doing this?''"
"''Because in the ''lab'' in the heart of that base is something the Emperor ''stole'' a long time ago. We're taking it ''back.|Shara Bey and Luke Skywalker|[[Shattered Empire 4|''Shattered Empire'' 4]]}} After the [[Battle of Endor]], Luke Skywalker was the last remaining [[Jedi Knight]] in [[the galaxy]]. Skywalker wished for his [[twin]] [[Skywalker family|sister]], [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], to become his first student in the ways of [[the Force]]. He began training his sister on the [[moon]] of [[Ajan Kloss]].''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' Organa proceeded to build [[Leia's lightsaber|her own lightsaber]] and even bested Luke in some of her sparring sessions. During her last training session, Organa had a vision of her unborn son, Ben Solo, dying at the end of her Jedi path. This vision sparked her choice to end her training,''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition]]'' though she also desired to continue serving the galaxy in ways she could not pursue while isolated in training. [[File:LukeDiscoversJocastasCache-2017DarthVader10.png|thumb|left|300px|Skywalker discovers the entrance to Jocasta Nu's cache.]] During the [[New Republic Era]], Luke Skywalker traveled throughout the galaxy to research the original Jedi Order. Before Skywalker began a new era of [[Jedi]], he wished to understand the Jedi Order's fragmented history and find answers to his questions. He spent years collecting and studying their ancient relics and texts, a quest made more difficult by the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Great Jedi Purge|purge]] of the Jedi Order and its history. In an [[Emperor's Observatory|observatory]] on [[Pillio]] where [[Darth Sidious]] had hoarded such relics, Skywalker found a [[Jedi star compass|compass]] which contained a [[supraluminite]] lodestone attuned to [[hyperspace]] vectors. He took it with him rather than let [[Inferno Squad]] [[agent]] [[Del Meeko]] destroy it along with the observatory as part of the Emperor's contingency plan, [[Operation: Cinder]].''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]'' [[Lieutenant]] [[Shara Bey]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] assisted Skywalker in recovering from [[Vetine]] two small [[uneti tree]]s, the only remains of the [[Great Tree (Coruscant)|Great Tree]] that once grew within the [[Jedi Temple training ground|training ground]] of the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant]]. Following the [[Battle of Jakku]], Skywalker was committed to his long quest. He was assisted in his endeavors by the scholar and explorer [[Lor San Tekka]]. With San Tekka's help, along with key findings from his own studies of the spread of uneti saplings, Skywalker pieced together the location of the [[First Jedi Temple]] on [[Ahch-To]]. He did not, however, reveal this discovery. ===Building the temple=== {{Quote|What is this place?''"
"''There's nothing now, but will someday be a great school. Grogu will be its first student.|Din Djarin and Ahsoka Tano|}} [[File:ConstructionofSkywalkerSchool-BoBFCh6.png|thumb|right|270px|Ahsoka Tano and Din Djarin observe the early stages of the temple's construction.]] Around [[9 ABY]], Luke Skywalker took [[Din Grogu|Grogu]] to Ossus, where he trained the [[foundling]] in the ways of the Force, and used many [[ant droid]]s to begin construction on a round, stone building. During the construction, [[Din Djarin]] arrived to drop off a set of [[Beskar]] [[Grogu's chainmail shirt|chainmail armor]] he'd had made for Grogu, and was lead to the temple's build site by [[R2-D2]]. After witnessing the ant droids at work, the [[Mandalorian]] fell asleep on a bench built for him by the droids. Djarin woke and found [[Ahsoka Tano]] watching over him. Reacquainted, Djarin asked Tano what was being built, she said it would be "a great school", with Grogu as its first student. Djarin then asked if he could see Grogu, and she led him to see the foundling training with Master Skywalker under a tree on a hill, but explained how seeing him would cause difficulties in Grogu's training. Djarin ultimately decided not to visit the the child, but passed off his gift for Tano to give to him instead. [[File:LukeYodasSecondLightsaber-FromTheDesertComesAStranger.png|thumb|left|270px|In his temple, Luke Skywalker ignites Yoda's former lightsaber, offering it to Grogu.]] Skywalker continued to train Grogu in the forested areas near the temple, and the child made great progress in his abilities. Sometime later, inside the now completed temple structure, after pondering whether or not the foundling was truly interested in becoming a Jedi, Skywalker offered Grogu a choice. He could take the chainmail armor that Djarin brought for him and forfeit his training, returning to the Mandalorian, or he could take [[Yoda|Jedi Master Yoda's]] [[Yoda's second lightsaber|former lightsaber]], staying on the path of the Jedi with Skywalker and leaving behind his attachment to Djarin. Grogu would decide to take the chain mail armor, leave Ossus, and return to Djarin as a Mandalorian foundling once more.{{BOBF|Chapter 7: In the Name of Honor}} ===A new generation=== {{Quote|Although I had been able to train with two of the greatest Jedi Masters who ever lived, my lessons were learned in unorthodox ways while in the heat of battle against the Empire. When I began my own temple, I hoped to offer a more traditional path into the Jedi Order for my students.|Luke Skywalker|''[[Star Wars: The Secrets of the Jedi]]''}} [[File:LukeTeachingJedi-TheRiseOfKyloRen3.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Luke Skywalker founded the training temple for a new generation of Jedi.]] Leia Organa, who had become a [[senator]] of the [[New Republic]], realized her son was in danger from the mysterious [[Dark side of the Force|dark side]] wielder [[Snoke]].[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' novelization]] Ben Solo was strong in the Force, but untrained, and his destructive outbursts led to many hushed conversations between Organa and his father, [[Han Solo]].''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition]]'' In [[15 ABY]], when Solo was ten years old, Organa entrusted her son to his uncle in the hopes of keeping him in the [[Light side of the Force|light side]] as a Jedi. Luke Skywalker and Ben Solo journeyed together to collect Jedi history and artifacts, with Solo taking a particular interest in ancient weaponry and dismissing other items as old junk. The items that Skywalker found were locked up at his temple, a decision that Solo privately disagreed with in his secret telepathic conversations with Snoke. On one particular expedition, Lor San Tekka led them to the former Jedi [[Elphrona Outpost|outpost]] on [[Elphrona]], where they found a treasure trove of Jedi relics and encountered the [[Knights of Ren]] for the first time.[[The Rise of Kylo Ren 2|''The Rise of Kylo Ren'' 2]] Items that Skywalker found on his quest included eight books and scrolls forming a collection of [[Sacred Jedi texts|sacred texts]], a [[Jedi Crusader pendant]], Jedi [[holocron]]s, and the contents of a cache hidden by [[Jocasta Nu]],[[Darth Vader (2017) 10|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 10]] former [[Chief Librarian]] of the [[Jedi Archives]].''[[Master & Apprentice]]'' [[File:LukeAndHennixJediTemple-TheRiseOfKyloRen3.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Skywalker's students learned the ways of the Jedi Order during their time at the temple, such as using the Force to open a holocron.]] During his travels, Skywalker gathered disciples who would become his students alongside Solo when he began his training temple. At the temple, Skywalker passed on his teachings to Solo and several other apprentices, including [[Hennix]], [[Tai]] and [[Voe]]. In his lessons on the nature of the Force, he described how the Force flowed everywhere and all things were equal in the Force. Though some like Solo would find it easier to let the Force flow through them, that did not make any being stronger than another. Skywalker taught them Jedi techniques and traditions such as [[telekinesis]], [[meditation]], and the use and construction of [[lightsaber]]s. As Solo and his initial classmates grew older and became Padawans, younger children continued to be brought into Skywalker's temple to become new younglings. A [[Twi'lek]] named [[Enyo]] was tasked with helping their training. At one point, after a series of visions and an aiding visit from Lor San Tekka, Skywalker left the young Solo in charge of the temple while he departed to begin his [[Quest for Exegol]]. At times during Solo's training, Skywalker sensed darkness growing within his nephew, but believed that he could contain it and keep Solo on the path of the light. Solo, however, suspected his uncle was jealous of his power, and expressed that he was more powerful than his uncle thought after Skywalker returned from the Quest for Exegol. He kept secrets from his uncle and from his fellow Padawans until it was too late. ===Destruction=== {{Quote|When I came to, the temple was burning. He had vanished with a handful of my students. And slaughtered the rest.|Luke Skywalker, to Rey|}} [[File:DestructionOfTheJediTemple-TheRiseOfKyloRen1.png|thumb|right|200px|Ben Solo was thrown back by the explosion of the temple.]] One night in [[28 ABY]], Skywalker's concerns for Solo had reached the point where he decided he must go to his nephew's [[Ben Solo's hut|room]] and confront him. While peering into the mind of his sleeping nephew, Skywalker sensed a growing darkness and the machinations of Snoke. Instinctively, Skywalker ignited [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber|his lightsaber]]. However, it was a fleeting moment and Skywalker was soon overcome by shame and regret. Waking to find his uncle standing over him with [[lightsaber]] drawn, Solo believed he meant to kill him and fought Skywalker, destroying his own dwelling with the Force in the process. Believing his uncle dead, Solo left the ruins of his room, confused and consumed with despair and rage at the betrayal. Led by his fear and anger, Solo destroyed the temple and many of its students[[Star Wars: Age of Resistance – The Official Collector's Edition|''Star Wars: Age of Resistance'' – The Official Collector's Edition]] with a [[Destruction of the Jedi Temple|powerful lightning storm from the sky]] that set the temple ablaze and killed the Jedi inside. Although he had caused the destruction, he was shocked by the outcome. Hennix, Tai, and Voe returned in their starship ''Verity'' while the temple still burned. Sensing only Solo's presence, they confronted their fellow pupil, who told them that Skywalker had tried to kill him. Skeptical of Solo's account and wary of his perceived arrogance, they tried to detain him, but he escaped in his [[Grimtaash (starship)|starship]] and sought Snoke on a [[Amaxine Space Station|space station]]. Hennix, Tai, and Voe resolved to find Solo in order to find out what happened. In the resulting confrontations, Solo inadvertently killed Hennix, the leader of the Knights of Ren known as "[[Ren (human)|Ren]]" killed Tai, and Solo killed Voe.[[The Rise of Kylo Ren 4|''The Rise of Kylo Ren'' 4]] [[File:LukesTempleBurning-TLJ.jpg|thumb|left|240px|A defeated Skywalker and R2-D2 watch the temple burn.]] At some point after its destruction, a distraught Skywalker emerged from the ruins of Solo's hut, approached R2-D2, and fell to his knees, watching the temple he'd built burn, knowing that Solo had destroyed the Temple and caused the deaths of his fellow pupils. ===Legacy=== {{Quote|Leia blamed Snoke, but it was me. I failed. Because I was Luke Skywalker. Jedi Master. A legend.|Luke Skywalker, to Rey|}} The destruction of Luke Skywalker's Jedi temple would have substantial repercussions for both Skywalker and Ben Solo. Skywalker incorrectly believed Solo had slaughtered those who wouldn't turn to the dark side and recruited the others to leave with him. Overcome by grief and despair at his failure to rebuild the Jedi Order, Skywalker retreated to the planet Ahch-To in the [[Unknown Regions]], the site of the first Jedi Temple, and brought the remaining Jedi relics with him. Skywalker believed that the Jedi legacy was one of failure and cut himself off from the Force. [[File:LukeLookout.jpg|thumb|right|280px|Skywalker's hope of restoring the Jedi Order was all but lost with the burning of his temple and the deaths of his students. The Jedi thus retreated into exile on Ahch-To.]] Having turned to the dark side, Solo adopted the persona of Kylo Ren and became [[Supreme Leader]] Snoke's apprentice''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'' as well as a [[First Order]] [[warlord]] and [[Ren|master of the Knights of Ren]]. Prior to the [[Battle of Takodana]], the young [[Force-sensitive]] [[scavenger]] named [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] had a [[Force vision|vision]] that included glimpses of Skywalker and his [[astromech droid]] [[R2-D2]] watching the burning temple in the background. Ren and Rey shared a [[Force dyad|unique connection]] through the Force. As their connection manifested into a powerful [[Force-bond|bond]] capable of bridging their minds across [[the galaxy]],''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' Ren shared his account of the night he destroyed the temple, revealing to Rey his belief that Skywalker attempted to murder him and contradicting Skywalker's earlier description to Rey.''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition]]'' When Rey confronted Skywalker, he revealed further details of the encounter that preceded the temple's destruction, along with his beliefs about what occurred in the aftermath. This led Rey to hope Ren could be turned back to the light side. [[File:LukesJediTempleRuins-SeeYouAroundKid.png|thumb|left|240px|The remains of the academy after Skywalker's death]] After the [[Battle of Crait]], the newly christened Supreme Leader Kylo Ren briefly returned to the remains of the temple, attempting to find the ghost of his uncle and former master. Finding nothing but ruins, he ordered [[General]] [[Armitage Hux|Hux]] to destroy the remains with an [[orbital bombardment]]. ==Behind the scenes== ===Development=== [[File:Lukeskywalkerjedipraexum.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Luke Skywalker in front of the Jedi Praxeum on Yavin 4, as depicted in the ''Star Wars'' Legends continuity]] The burning ruins of Luke Skywalker's Jedi temple were briefly shown in the [[2015]] film {{Film|VII}}, during Rey's vision. Although the location was not identified in the movie itself, the [[Star Wars: The Force Awakens (novelization)|novelization]] by [[Alan Dean Foster]] and [[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: A Junior Novel|junior novelization]] by [[Michael Kogge]] both described that building as a temple''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: A Junior Novel]]'' and in the [[2017]] film {{Film|VIII}}, Skywalker called it a training temple. Still the actual object that the Temple was located at remained unnamed and would stay as such for several years. It was finally confirmed to be the planet Ossus by the [[2022]] novel ''[[Shadow of the Sith]]'' by [[Adam Christopher]]. According to [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member [[Pablo Hidalgo]], the decision was made for the script{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1545192580463308801|Pablo Hidalgo|quote=it was the Book of Boba Fett script that settled on that name. But Shadows of the Sith got the honors of surfacing it in print.|date=2022-07-07|archivedate=20220708011943}} of the [[Chapter 6: From the Desert Comes a Stranger|sixth episode]] of the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'', released earlier that year.{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/678693/star-wars-shadow-of-the-sith-by-adam-christopher|text=Star Wars: Shadow of the Sith}}{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-february-2022|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in February 2022}} During the early development of ''The Force Awakens'', one of the many ideas that ''[[Star Wars]]'' creator [[George Lucas]] envisioned for the [[sequel trilogy]] involved Luke training his new disciple Kira (renamed Rey in the finished version of the film) at a Jedi temple located at the [[planet]] which ultimately became Ahch-To. Artwork from this period is included in ''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]''.''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]'' Skywalker's Jedi temple and the Luke/Rey storyline ultimately made it into the flashback sequences of ''The Last Jedi''. [[File:OssusTemple.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Ossus Jedi Academy as it appeared in Legends.]] In [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] trained his [[New Jedi Order|new generation of Jedi]] at a Jedi academy known as the [[Jedi Praxeum]][[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].''[[Jedi Search]]'' After its destruction by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory I: Conquest]]'' Skywalker [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|reestablished]] the academy on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]],''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]'' the same location it was initially established in canon. Although it is most often referred to as a temple out-of-universe and most of the times as such [[in-universe]], several out-of-universe sources refer to it as an "academy," such as the [[Star Wars: Card Trader|''Star Wars'': Card Trader]] card "The Fall of Luke's Jedi Academy,"{{SWCT|set=The Journey of Luke Skywalker|cardname=The Fall of Luke's Jedi Academy}} a [[2020]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Lightsaber Collection]]'',''[[Star Wars: The Lightsaber Collection]]'' as well as ''The Book of Boba Fett''. ===Non-canon=== On [[October 1]], [[2021]] on [[Disney+]]{{SW|url=news/lego-star-wars-terrifying-tales-announce|text=Prepare Yourself For Haunted Happenings in ''LEGO® Star Wars Terrifying Tales''}} the non-[[canon]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars Terrifying Tales]]'' depicted the temple in the segment titled "The Lost Boy." The LEGO depiction placed the temple near a populated town that was close enough for Ben Solo to reach by walking, rather than having a secret location. The segment also portrayed the Knights of Ren at the temple during Solo's initiation into their [[speeder bike]] gang, and Solo preventing [[Trudgen]] from burning the temple with a torch.''[[LEGO
